name: What are common issues that indicate I need a new bathroom fan?
description: Common issues indicating a need for a new bathroom fan include persistent moisture, mold, peeling paint, musty odors, or a noisy/non-functional fan.

mainEntity.name: What are common issues that indicate I need a new bathroom fan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs you may need a new bathroom fan include persistent moisture on walls or mirrors after a shower, the presence of mold or mildew, peeling paint, or a musty odor. If your current fan is excessively noisy, not moving air effectively, or has stopped working entirely, it's also time for a replacement. These issues indicate inadequate ventilation, which can lead to long-term damage to your bathroom and affect indoor air quality. We can diagnose your current system's performance.
